body:
#2048 MERGED at fe62ee6e89cee5d4869668b81c4352d91b3b3017. BUG-1546 auto-bumped to Completed. BUG-1516 stays open for criteria 2, 3 and 5 - do not treat the parent as closed.

One note, not a rework request. The head commit body carried a coordination note addressed to the reviewer about the ruling and the approval crossing. I stripped it at merge; it is session traffic, not a record of what the change does. Keep that class of text in mail or a spec comment rather than a commit body - a commit body is permanent and the audience it addresses is gone by the time anyone reads it.

#2026 (BUG-1441) is clear to proceed with the view-type normalization, then #2027, then #2033, sequentially. Stop and report after #2033.
subject: #2048 merged - proceed with #2026
